fields.summary: Production Alert: notification-worker failure caused by memory_leak
fields.description:
Service notification-worker reported critical errors. Root cause category is memory_leak.
Trace:
File "app/notification-worker/handler.py", line 42, in process
Exception: memory_leak exception occurred.

comments.body: Mitigated issue by restarting notification-worker and applying runbook RB-db-pool-exhaustion.
